candidates.title: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems
candidates.reason: Systems characterization of agentic workloads with production traces and concrete serving design explorations. It quantifies sandbox memory, heterogeneous resource affinity, idle persistent state, control-plane overhead, and caching opportunities, with measured improvements from placement/offload/cache designs.

candidates.title: FlexServe: A Fast and Secure LLM Serving System for Mobile Devices with Flexible Resource Isolation
candidates.reason: Implemented mobile LLM serving system with flexible TrustZone memory/NPU isolation, LLM-aware memory management, secure pipeline, and multi-model scheduler. It has direct systems relevance and substantial measured TTFT/end-to-end improvements.

rejected_candidates.title: PrefixBench-H100: Characterizing Prefix Reuse and Time-to-First-Token in H100 LLM Serving
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: Useful benchmark/characterization but explicitly does not introduce a new caching or serving mechanism; lower priority than mechanism-bearing systems papers for this repository's discovery criteria.

discovery_stats.axis: agentic workload characterization / sandbox memory / secure mobile serving
discovery_stats.query_summary: Expanded agentic serving beyond scheduler-only work into systems characterization, sandbox/resource isolation, and prefix-cache measurement. Two mechanism-bearing systems candidates were accepted; a benchmark-only prefix study was rejected with reason.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: Switch to MoE expert placement/prefetch/cache or inference framework runtime updates to maintain independent coverage.
